svg.title: System Defence Rock - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Small Craft Catalogue (2023), printed 62, PDF 63. Illustration-informed interpretation: broad asymmetric rounded asteroid uses deck footprint proportions, with irregular softened perimeter inferred from the rock illustration. Rectangular room footprint shoulders are not treated as exposed exterior hull. Exact natural surface irregularities are not fixed by plan. Bow convention right-to-up.
